raw_text: A deal brokered by Belarusian President Lukashenko has ended the Wagner mutiny. Prigozhin agreed to halt the march on Moscow and relocate Wagner forces to Belarus. Criminal charges against Prigozhin will reportedly be dropped. The column has begun turning around south of Moscow. Putin's authority faces unprecedented questions after the 24-hour crisis.
clean_text: Lukashenko-brokered deal ends Wagner mutiny. Prigozhin halts march, Wagner forces to relocate to Belarus. Criminal charges to be dropped. Column turning around south of Moscow.
